scouting.summary: Walks forward behind punches and chops the legs with low kicks and calf kicks until you can't stand.
weaknesses: Stands on one leg every time he kicks
Falls apart against a clinch fighter, worst of all on the fence
scouting.tell: When his jab is blocked he follows with a calf kick.
scouting.how_to_beat: Check or catch the kicks, counter when he's on one leg, and take him down or tie him up on the fence.
